title: Block - Summit Feedback Survey

fields.label: Audience
fields.name: audience
fields.instructions: UK shows the survey in English. FR shows it in French. Answers from both are stored in English in the same place (Summit > Feedback survey).

fields.label: Closing date
fields.name: closing_date
fields.instructions: Shown in the introduction, in the page's language, e.g. "Friday 13 November 2026" or "vendredi 13 novembre 2026". Leave empty to hide the sentence.

fields.label: Privacy policy URL
fields.name: privacy_url
fields.instructions: PDF linked beside the optional name and email fields. Leave empty to hide the link.

fields.label: Summit logo URL
fields.name: logo_url
fields.instructions: Optional. Shown at the top of the survey. The dark Summit logo, since it sits on the light background.

description: Language, closing date and links for the Summit feedback survey. The questions themselves are fixed in the theme.
